beats.label: Weekend lie-ins
beats.text: If you **sleep** **in** on weekends, read this.

beats.label: The data
beats.text: **10,000+** adults wore sleep **trackers.** Over **1 million** nights logged.
beats.note: Preliminary abstract, AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 (NIH All of Us)

beats.label: When bedtimes drift
beats.text: Shifting sleep timing was linked to **20 to 23%** higher risk of **heart** **attack,** stroke or heart failure.

beats.label: Every 29 minutes
beats.text: Each **29-minute** jump in night-to-night swing: about **24%** higher risk.

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: **Not** peer-reviewed yet. A **link,** not proof. Trackers only **estimate** sleep.
Follow for sleep studies **without** the **scare** headlines.
